cands.name: Jon Fay
cands.bio: Republican candidate for House District 2 (parts of Escambia and Santa Rosa counties). Naval Academy graduate (2000), retired Navy naval flight officer after 24 years; former Blue Angels executive officer; Navy legislative fellow in the U.S. House.
cands.local_ties: FL DOE filing address is in Santa Rosa County; Florida Politics (Apr 2, 2025) quotes him on serving families across Escambia and Santa Rosa counties.

record.text: Graduated U.S. Naval Academy 2000 (played running back); 24 years as a naval flight officer incl. support of Operation Enduring Freedom; Executive Officer for the Blue Angels; retired from the Navy in 2024; Navy Legislative Fellow in the U.S. House during the 115th Congress. Private sector: Director of Surplus Solutions at Airline MRO Parts. (Per his campaign announcement as reported by Florida Politics.)

cands.gaps: Endorsements, donors, social links and any photo not found (search budget exhausted). Spelling: DOE and Florida Politics use "Jon"; the Wikipedia 2026 House page text says "John Fay".
